'''Wumdi''' was an [[Etti]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] reign.

==History==
Vigo Wumdi, an Etti, operated in his native [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], promoting Black Sun's interests in it. His criminal network involved bribed [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|CSA]] officials, [[Security Police|Espos]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] workers, [[agent/Legends|agents]] and [[slicer/Legends|slicers]], even reprogrammed [[droid/Legends|droids]], who stole information or shipments. His inside information, helped him maneuver within the fluctuating economy of the Sector, and adjust his criminal activities accordingly. He ran [[casino/Legends|casinos]] and pleasure palaces for the local employees, while he sold corporate secrets or used incriminating data for blackmailing.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In the past the [[Pike Sisters]] worked for Wumdi as [[assassin/Legends|assassins]], until they changed their name and became freelancer [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].<ref name="SEE3">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 3]]</ref>

Wumdi's greed led him to skim significant sums from Black Sun, somehow unaware that Xizor had his own spies within Wumdi's network,<ref name="sb" /> and mistakenly thought that he would know first if Xizor found out.<ref name="obvious">{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied; Wumdi had bought a conservative corporate tunic specifically for that meeting. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Wumdi he vainly thought that if Xizor knew something about him, he would know it too; he tried to keep his calm and charm, and checked his hair and attire in front of an ornate [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]], until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref name="obvious" /> At the conclusion of the meeting, Wumdi witnessed as Xizor had [[Guri]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

After Xizor's death in the [[Battle over Coruscant]], Wumdi was present in a Vigo council about the future of Black Sun. He and [[Clezo]] expressed their distate when [[Lonay]] behaved as he was the head of the council, and he refused to take orders from a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]; he seemed to like a mysterious attractive [[human/Legends|human]] woman, and reminisced of the Pike sisters.<ref name="SEE3" />

During a later meeting, the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] showed up after the human female's invitation. Then the room was invaded by thugs, who were quickly slaughtered. The human female identified the bodies as [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker's]] soldiers; nobody knew that the mysterious human who was actually [[Savan]] in disguise, and the one responsible for the attack to incriminate Vekker. Savan claimed that Clezo's and Wumdi's troops would soon be after Vekker.<ref name="SEE3" />
==Personality and traits==
Wumdi had a slim figure. He usually wore tunics and robes of light fabric.<ref name="sb" />

He was really wealthy and liked to show it, within his ejnerally cheerful and optimistic attitude; although he avoided displaying his wealth in front of Xizor. The only jewelry he wore was an [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]] circlet around his head.<ref name="sb" />
